verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at api-dashboard.search.brave.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the API for LLM readers. Many docs and API-reference pages are also served as markdown (index.html.md paths), and a Skills resource targets coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs, and consistent markdown coverage (the /app/documentation.md path returns 404).
